from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class IFCFinancialsFY24:
    """
    A dataclass storing the International Finance Corporation's (IFC) 
    key financial figures for the fiscal year 2024 (FY24), ended June 30, 2024.
    
    All base figures are represented in millions of US Dollars (USD), 
    consistent with the presentation currency in the IFC Consolidated Financial Statements.
    
    Citations:
    - Net Income ($1,485 million): IFC Annual Report 2024 Financials, Page 64, Consolidated Statements of Operations.
    - Total Assets ($108,187 million): IFC Annual Report 2024 Financials, Page 63, Consolidated Balance Sheets.
    """
    net_income_usd_millions: int = 1485
    total_assets_usd_millions: int = 108187

    @property
    def net_income_usd(self) -> int:
        """Returns the net income in absolute US Dollars."""
        return self.net_income_usd_millions * 1_000_000

    @property
    def total_assets_usd(self) -> int:
        """Returns the total assets in absolute US Dollars."""
        return self.total_assets_usd_millions * 1_000_000

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return (
            f"IFC FY24 Financial Performance:\n"
            f"---------------------------------\n"
            f"Net Income:   ${self.net_income_usd_millions:,} million (${self.net_income_usd:,})\n"
            f"Total Assets: ${self.total_assets_usd_millions:,} million (${self.total_assets_usd:,})\n"
        )
